about_the_game:
Find Oann is a single-player horror shooter with an intense and mysterious story.

The game delivers an intense action experience without compromising the immersion of a compelling narrative. All mechanics are relatively simple, but since there is no difficulty selection, the game can be considered challenging, as combat is aggressive and requires practice to master.

Synopsis

Thomas is a geologist on a routine job when, mysteriously, monsters start appearing, trying to kill him. What initially seems like an unexpected nightmare soon reveals itself to be part of a larger plan when he discovers instructions to find someone named Oann and save him.

Gameplay

  • Explore and find items, story notes, and weapons.

  • Manage your stamina to dodge enemy attacks during combat.

  • Use your rage doses to obliterate enemies.

  • Set bear traps to restrain your enemies.

  • Ignite areas to control fights against multiple enemies using gasoline canisters.

INCLUDED WITH PURCHASE

  • Complete single-player campaign

  • Future updates for bug fixes

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains scenes with excessive visible blood and bodies. Monster-type enemies die (only when using the Extraterrestrial Weapon), disappearing into a splash of blood in the air.
